Line %1$d · Column %2$d
Missing required argument: %1$s
Pass a value for %1$s at this call. The editor’s Fix (Kotlin) action may offer a placeholder; replace it with a real value before running.
Unknown parameter: %1$s
Check the parameter name against the function declaration and the library version in this project.
Too many arguments
Compare the call with the function declaration. Remove extra arguments or choose the intended overload.
No matching function call
More than one function matches this call
Check argument names, count and types. The signatures below are alternatives, not separate fixes that must all be applied.
Cannot resolve: %1$s
Check spelling, imports and downloaded project dependencies. Use Fix (Kotlin) to see available import suggestions.
Value type does not match the required type
Compare the actual and expected types in the complete diagnostic below, including whether null is allowed.
Composable call outside a Composable context
Call this function from a @Composable function or lambda. Only add @Composable if the enclosing function is intended to build UI.
Suspend call outside a coroutine
Call this function from a coroutine or another suspend function. In Compose, use an appropriate effect such as LaunchedEffect for side effects.
Receiver may be null
Check for null or use a safe call (?.). Do not use !! unless the value is guaranteed to be non-null.
